about: GMR Airports Limited development, maintenance, and operation of airports in India. It is also involved in operation of international airports on build, own, operate, and transfer basis. In addition, the company engages in construction business, including engineering, procurement, and construction contracting activities; and provides security services, as well as engages in maintenance, repairing, and overhauling of aircrafts. The company was formerly known as GMR Airports Infrastructure Limited
